publication_status.evidence: arXiv abs page 2007.12320 has no journal_ref field, only comment 'accepted for publication in The Astronomical Journal'. Published version confirmed via Crossref API https://api.crossref.org/works/10.3847/1538-3881/aba957 : container 'The Astronomical Journal', vol 160, issue 4, page 158, issued 2020-09-10, title 'MIRC-X: A Highly Sensitive Six-telescope Interferometric Imager at the CHARA Array'.

method: Sec. 5.6 (pp. 21-22): three methods: (i) squeeze model-independent image reconstruction (regularizer weight 1000, 5 chains x 500 iterations, 256x256 grid, ~0.1 mas/pixel, chi2~2); (ii) CANDID binary detection (confirms parameters within 3.4 sigma); (iii) in-house model fitting (software 'available upon request'), initialised from squeeze results, with bandwidth smearing, stellar diameters fixed at 1.05 and 0.6 mas. Orbit: least-squares fit of Campbell elements to the five astrometric points (Fig. 25, Table 3). Priors not stated. Calibrator gamma Peg (H diameter 0.3719123 +/- 0.02 mas, JSDC), App. C p. 26.
flux_ratio_definition: 'F_pri/sec' = flux ratio of primary to secondary (Table 2 header; text p. 22: 'flux ratio of primary to secondary F_pri/sec of 4.6 +/- 0.1'). H band implied (MIRC-X H-band data) but band not explicitly stated in the passage. NB primary/secondary, i.e. >1; invert for secondary/primary (~0.217).
uncertainties: Table 2 errors are the fit errors; no mention of inflation. Table 3: semi-major axis footnote '* 0.5% uncertainty in the semi-major due to uncertain absolute wavelength calibration' (i.e. the quoted +/-0.0038 mas is statistical only, 0.5% systematic additional). Median orbit residual 6.65 uas (Fig. 25 caption). Model-fit vs CANDID differences up to 3.3 sigma (Table 2 last columns).

conventions.PA: North up, East to the left in images (Fig. 24/25); PA of secondary relative to primary presumed east of north, not stated explicitly in the text read
conventions.omega: Table 3 'Longitude of the periastron'; whose component not stated
conventions.Omega: Table 3 footnote: 'Our orbit Omega is not in J2000, apparent North-East precession.' (i.e. epoch-of-date frame)
conventions.other: Table 3 T_peri unit not stated in the table (value 52997.4686, presumably MJD). Epoch MJDs not given in the paper (null here).

other_papers: Searched arXiv/web: Gardner et al. 2022 (ARMADA II, arXiv:2209.00669, AJ doi 10.3847/1538-3881/ac8eae) mentions MIRC-X wavelength correction factor 1.0054 +/- 0.0006 but its text contains no iota Peg orbit/epochs (grep for 'Peg' found nothing relevant). The MIRC-X paper says the etalon wavelength calibration is 'Gardner et al., in prep'. No separate published iota Peg orbit using these five epochs found.
notes: Headline result: Table 2 squeeze+model fitting (not CANDID) is the basis for the orbit. Flux ratio 4.6 +/- 0.1 is a summary value in text. Page numbers refer to the printed AJ layout as reproduced in the arXiv PDF (journal pagination 'N. Anugu et al.' headers). Orbit only constrains MIRC-X astrometry; wavelength-scale systematic 0.5% on separations not included in Table 2.
